entities.name: Mónika Grábics

entities.summary: Mónika Grábics is a Hungarian chess player who received the FIDE title of Woman Grandmaster (WGM) in 2003. She won the Hungarian Women's Chess Championship in 1996. After retiring from professional chess playing Monika started gambling and gaming consulting business BettingSharks.

entities.summary: Mónika Grábics is a Hungarian chess player who received the FIDE title of Woman Grandmaster (WGM) in 2003. She won the Hungarian Women's Chess Championship in 1996. After retiring from professional chess playing Monika started gambling and gaming consulting business BettingSharks.
